urdu transliteration: Khoone sarwar bahany aya hay shimr khanjar chalany aya hay\nFatima ko rulaany aya hay shimr khanjar chalany aya hay
english translation text: He has come to shed the blood of the Master — Shimr has come to strike with the dagger.\nHe has come to make Lady Fatima al-Zahra weep — Shimr has come to strike with the dagger.

urdu transliteration: Kaise dekhegi khoo'n bhara manzar\nkaise rakhy gi hath gardan par\nMaamta aazmany aya hay shimr khanjar chalany aya hay
english translation text: How will a mother bear to witness this scene drenched in blood?\nHow will she place her hand upon her son's wounded neck?\nHe has come to put a mother's love to the cruelest test. Shimr has come to strike with the dagger.

urdu transliteration: Jis ne apny lahu se seencha hay\nJis ne chakki Chala k Pala hay\nAisi maa ko sataany aya hay shimr khanjar chalany aya hay
english translation text: She who nurtured him with her own blood and soul.\nShe who raised him through sacrifice, labour, and hardship.\nHe has come to torment such a noble mother. Shimr has come to strike with the dagger.

urdu transliteration: Sheh k seeny pe baith kar zaalim\nHath daaly ga reesh par zalim\nYe qayamat wo dhaany aya hay shimr khanjar chalany aya hay
english translation text: The tyrant will sit upon the chest of the Master.\nThe tyrant will seize his blessed beard with his hand.\nHe has come to bring a scene like the Day of Judgment. Shimr has come to strike with the dagger.

urdu transliteration: Jis pe bandha Rasool ne bosa\nAb sitamgar wahi gala pyasa\nKaat kar khoo'n bahaany aya hay shimr khanjar chalany aya hay
english translation text: That throat upon which the Messenger of God placed kisses.\nNow that same sacred throat is left parched with thirst by the oppressor.\nHe has come to sever it and let the blood flow. Shimr has come to strike with the dagger.

urdu transliteration: Bain Hain Syeda sakina k\nBand paani Kiya gaya pehly\nAb yatima banany aya hay shimr khanjar chalany aya hay
english translation text: These are the heart-rending cries of Lady Sakina bint Hussain.\nFirst, the water was cut off from them.\nNow he has come to make her an orphan. Shimr has come to strike with the dagger.

urdu transliteration: Sirf sattar qadam se ye manzar\nKaise daikhy gi Zainab e muztar\nDil Behan ka dukhany aya hay shimr khanjar chalany aya hay
english translation text: Only seventy steps away stands this tragic scene.\nHow will the Sayyida Zainab bint Ali bear to witness this scene?\nHe has come to break a sister's heart. Shimr has come to strike with the dagger.

urdu transliteration: Maa ne Yasir ye phir kaha ghazi\nUth mery Laal ko bacha ghazi\nTera zarbe'n lagaany aya hay shimr khanjar chalany aya hay
english translation text: The mother cried again and said, O Abbas ibn Ali, my brave standard-bearer!\nRise and save my beloved son, O Ghazi!\nHe has come to wound him with brutal blows. Shimr has come to strike with the dagger.

urdu transliteration: Ashqiya ne kaha kuchal den ge\nIs ko tukron may ham badal den gy\nJis k sar ko uraany aya hay shimr khanjar chalany aya hay
english translation text: The tyrant said: We shall trample him.\nWe shall tear his body into pieces.\nHe has come to sever the head of the Master. Shimr has come to strike with the dagger.
